result.summary: Adds a test case to wallet_startup.py verifying that reloading a wallet with load_on_startup=True when it is already present in the startup list skips writing dynamic settings. Under -nosettings, this ensures the call succeeds without emitting a warning. The test exercises the short-circuit logic introduced in PR #36176.
result.problem: Functional test coverage lacked verification for an edge case introduced in PR #36176, where re-adding a wallet already in the startup list should evaluate to SKIP_WRITE before checking whether dynamic settings write paths are enabled.
evidence: PR description notes the edge case was suggested by reviewer jeanpablojp in PR #36176 review comments (https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/36176#discussion_r3944837660)
result.scope_notes: A small test-only addition of 5 lines in test/functional/wallet_startup.py.
result.changed_since_previous: None; the previous description was generated without a diff, and the diff matches the earlier summary.
result.card: Adds a test case to wallet_startup.py checking that reloading an already-registered wallet with load_on_startup=True skips writing settings and emits no warnings under -nosettings. This improves test coverage for the dynamic settings short-circuit logic merged in PR #36176. The edge case was suggested during the review of PR #36176.

risk.why: A flaw in this change would only cause false test failures in wallet_startup.py and cannot affect node behavior.
